definitions.gloss: useful tool; convenient device; sharp instrument
definitions.explanation: A handy implement or technology that makes work easier. Most often appears in the set phrase {文明|ぶんめい}の{利器|りき} (the conveniences of civilization).

examples.japanese: ⟦スマホ→スマホ：04721_sumaho⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{文明|ぶんめい}→文明：03611_bunmei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{利器|りき}だ。
examples.english: The smartphone is a convenience of modern civilization.

examples.japanese: ⟦{洗濯機|せんたくき}→洗濯機：04969_sentakuki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{家事|かじ}→家事：12313_kaji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{楽|らく}にする→楽にする：27269_rakunisuru⟧{利器|りき}だ。
examples.english: The washing machine is a handy device that makes housework easier.

examples.japanese: ⟦{文明|ぶんめい}→文明：03611_bunmei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{利器|りき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{頼|たよ}り→頼る：02069_tayoru⟧すぎる⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{不便|ふべん}→不便：01501_fuben⟧な⟦{状況|じょうきょう}→状況：01576_joukyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{弱|よわ}く→弱い：00825_yowai⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: If you rely too much on the conveniences of civilization, you become helpless in inconvenient situations.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{利|り}→利：29142_ri⟧ (benefit, sharpness) + {器|き} (implement). Somewhat literary; in everyday use it almost always appears in the fixed phrase below.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{文明|ぶんめい}→文明：03611_bunmei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{利器|りき}: the conveniences of civilization (technology, gadgets)
- ⟦{最新|さいしん}→最新：04831_saishin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{利器|りき}: the latest convenient device

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{道具|どうぐ}→道具：01479_dougu⟧: tool; implement — the ordinary, neutral word for any tool
- ⟦{器具|きぐ}→器具：03980_kigu⟧: apparatus; appliance — a specific piece of equipment for a purpose
